sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Today, you may experience the juxtaposition of pleasure and pain. Household tasks may weigh you down around afternoon. Later in the day, you will be able to achieve whatever you desire solely on account of your determination and mental strength. Pleasure awaits in the warmth and company of your soul mate, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: One of your ambitions in life is to be financially independent, and lately you might have made great strides toward attaining that goal. Today, through no fault of your own, you may receive information that indicates there may have been a setback. However, all is not as it seems. Don't go into a panic until you know all the facts, Taurus. You're probably still right on track.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Applying self-care practices to your wellness agenda will make it easier to stay on track, darling bull. As Venus retrogrades into Libra, be mindful of your health, making adjustments to improve how you look and feel. Luckily, as the Aries Moon aligns with Jupiter, the nodes of fate, Chiron, and Venus rx, you'll find the support and motivation you need to establish and maintain workable goals. You'll shine vibrantly when the Full Moon rises in your sign this evening, which grants permission to prioritize personal needs. Try not to overextend yourself with unrealistic expectations when Pluto grows agitated tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Your hope will bloom like a rich delicate fragrant and dazzling flower. Do not take any step or act in such a manner which can cause financial loss today without the advice of an experienced person. The jovial nature of family members will lighten up the atmosphere at home. You need to move out and rub elbows with people at high places. People first try to get money at the expense of health, and later try to get their good health back at the expense of money. Health is the real wealth, so get rid of laziness and live an active life.

readings.text: You may not tend to work hard for success, rather you may depend more on your luck today. Achieving a certain result will be so important to you that you won’t mind compromising on the quality of work. However, you need to maintain efficiency and quality both, suggests Ganesha.

Your perception is quite keen. You are able to see things that other people can't. This gives you a tremendous advantage over most everyone around you. As you move throughout the day, slowly and quietly gather pertinent facts and information.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that today you are going to make good money. As planetary positions are good, you will be able to earn through dual or more than two sources. It’s good time to talk to people about work.

You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

readings.text: Ganesha does not find you facing any health issue today. You will however not be in a mood to put in long hours at work. You will want to relax. You will be trying to balance your energy by taking necessary rest.

Today's aspect makes you feel more emotional for a couple of days. Notice what feelings come up and treat yourself gently. Keep on top of your health, though. There is no reason why you can't be gentle with yourself and still break a sweat in the gym, if possible! In fact, as emotions get processed it can be beneficial to exercise your body and release toxins at the same time. Be sure to drink plenty of water to make it a cleansing experience.
